description: Mexico carries one of the world's heaviest diabetes burdens, with complications - amputation, dialysis, blindness - arriving in working life rather than in old age.

aspect: Dialysis is a full-time unpaid job
description: Three sessions a week ends most manual employment, converting a chronic illness into the loss of the household income described in MEN-004.
time_note: Approx. days per year in treatment.
energy_note: Three days a week, forever, and no job survives it.

description: OCC-003's chronic kidney disease of non-traditional origin compounds this in agricultural populations on both sides of the border.
energy_note: The fields take the kidneys too.

description: Dialysis at forty-six. Three mornings a week, four hours each, plus travel. No employer will take him on those terms and he has no contributions behind him because of the informality in ECO-001. His son leaves school at sixteen to drive a delivery route.
energy_note: His son leaves school so he can keep having dialysis.
